name: entity-to-struct-pseudocode
body:
emit('type '+name+' struct {')
for f in fields:
  line = '\t'+f.name+' '+f.type
  if f.tag: line += ' `json:"'+f.tag+'"`'
  emit(line)
emit('}')
return gofmt(buffer)
residual: near-zero — a local open-weight model transcribes the pseudocode to its host language
